# Sex & age distributions across the latitudinal gradient

```{r}
#| label: fig-sex-age-ratio-latitude
#| fig-cap: Distribution of sampled sex and age classes by breeding latitudes which motivates conditioning on these covariates in regression models. Note in particular the skewed age and sex ratios at the sites around 40 degrees North in Whip-poor-wills. 
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7

sex_density <- analysis_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = B.Lat, color = Sex)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Density", color = "Sex")

age_density <- analysis_df %>%
  filter(Species != "Nighthawk") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.Lat, color = Age)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Breeding latitude", y = "Density", color = "Age class")

plot_grid(sex_density, age_density, ncol = 1, labels = c("a", "b"))
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-z-standardized
#| include: false

metrics_raw <- c("Wing.comb", "Tail.comb", "Mass.comb", "PC1", "SAtoV.comb")
metrics_z <- paste0(metrics_raw, ".z")
metric_labels <- c(
  "Wing.comb" = "Wing",
  "Tail.comb" = "Tail",
  "Mass.comb" = "Mass",
  "PC1" = "PC1",
  "SAtoV.comb" = "SA/V"
)

analysis_df_z <- analysis_df %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(metrics_raw), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)), .names = "{.col}.z")) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Slopes all age X sex combinations

```{r}
#| label: predicted-relationships-fns

# Specify full formulas for each species
rhs_full <- c(
  "Whip-poor-will" = "B.Lat + Age_grp + Sex",
  "Nightjar" = "B.Lat + Age_grp + Sex",
  "Nighthawk" = "B.Lat + Sex"
)

make_prediction_grid <- function(dat, model_obj) {
  lat_seq <- seq(min(dat$B.Lat), max(dat$B.Lat), length.out = 150)

  if ("Age_grp" %in% names(model.frame(model_obj))) {
    expand_grid(
      B.Lat = lat_seq,
      Age_grp = sort(unique(dat$Age_grp)),
      Sex = sort(unique(as.character(dat$Sex)))
    )
  } else {
    expand_grid(
      B.Lat = lat_seq,
      Sex = sort(unique(as.character(dat$Sex)))
    )
  }
}

fit_metric_model <- function(dat, metric, rhs) {
  mod <- lm(as.formula(glue("{metric} ~ {rhs}")), data = dat)
  tibble(
    metric = metric,
    n = nobs(mod),
    r2 = summary(mod)$r.squared,
    vif = mean(car::vif(mod)),
    model = list(mod)
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: predicted-relationships-tbls

pred_tbl <- analysis_df_z %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(models = map2(data, Species, function(d, sp) {
    map(metrics_z, function(m) fit_metric_model(d, m, rhs_full[[sp]])) %>% list_rbind()
  })) %>%
  select(Species, data, models) %>%
  unnest(models) %>%
  mutate(pred = map2(data, model, function(d, mod) {
    newdat <- make_prediction_grid(d, mod)
    newdat %>% mutate(fit = predict(mod, newdata = newdat))
  })) %>%
  select(Species, metric, pred) %>%
  unnest(pred) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = recode(str_remove(metric, "\\.z$"), !!!metric_labels),
    stratum = if_else(Species == "Nighthawk", Sex, paste(Age_grp, Sex, sep = "_"))
  )

obs_long <- analysis_df_z %>%
  select(Species, B.Lat, stratum, all_of(metrics_z)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(metrics_z), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = recode(str_remove(metric, "\\.z$"), !!!metric_labels))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-15-panel-plot
#| fig-cap: Observed standardized trait values and model-predicted latitudinal trends for each species and metric. Gray points are observations, colored lines are fitted values for each age-sex stratum (or sex only in nighthawk).
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7.5
#| fig-pos: 'H'

ggplot(obs_long, aes(x = B.Lat, y = value)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.7, color = "gray50") +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_tbl,
    aes(y = fit, color = stratum, group = interaction(stratum, metric, Species)),
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_grid(Species ~ metric) +
  labs(x = "Breeding latitude", y = "Scaled body size (z)", color = "Stratum") +
  ylim(-2.75, 3.75) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10))
```

```{r}
#| label: variance-partition

variance_components_one <- function(dat, species_name, metric) {
  full_rhs <- rhs_full[[species_name]]
  mod_full <- lm(as.formula(glue("{metric} ~ {full_rhs}")), data = dat)
  r2_full <- summary(mod_full)$r.squared

  predictors <- str_split(full_rhs, "\\s*\\+\\s*")[[1]]

  unique_tbl <- map(predictors, function(pred) {
    rhs_wo <- predictors[predictors != pred]
    rhs_wo <- if (length(rhs_wo) == 0) "1" else paste(rhs_wo, collapse = " + ")
    mod_wo <- lm(as.formula(glue("{metric} ~ {rhs_wo}")), data = dat)
    tibble(component = pred, value = r2_full - summary(mod_wo)$r.squared)
  }) %>% list_rbind()

  comp_lbl <- c(
    "B.Lat" = "Latitude",
    "Age_grp" = "Age",
    "Sex" = "Sex"
  )

  unique_tbl <- unique_tbl %>%
    mutate(component = recode(component, !!!comp_lbl))

  shared <- r2_full - sum(unique_tbl$value)
  residual <- 1 - r2_full

  bind_rows(
    unique_tbl,
    tibble(component = "Shared", value = shared),
    tibble(component = "Residuals", value = residual)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      metric = recode(str_remove(metric, "\\.z$"), !!!metric_labels),
      pct = 100 * value
    ) %>%
    select(metric, component, pct)
}

variance_tbl <- analysis_df_z %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(vp = map2(data, Species, function(d, sp) {
    map(metrics_z, function(m) variance_components_one(d, sp, m)) %>% list_rbind()
  })) %>%
  select(Species, vp) %>%
  unnest(vp)

# Is this really valid? 
variance_tbl2 <- variance_tbl %>%
  group_by(Species, metric) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * abs(pct) / sum(abs(pct))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Age & sex impact on precision

```{r}
#| label: fig-precision
#| fig-cap: Precision of latitude-slope estimates across model specifications and body-size metrics. Boxplots show the distribution of 95% confidence-interval widths (conf.high − conf.low), where smaller values indicate greater precision.
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| fig-pos: 'H'

slope_tbl %>%
  mutate(ci.size = conf.high - conf.low) %>%
  group_by(Species, metric, model_type) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_ci = mean(ci.size),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model_type, y = mean_ci, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.35)) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "95% CI width for beta latitude (scaled)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)
  )
```

# Post-hoc Nighthawk tail length

```{r}
#| label: fig-post-hoc-lat2
#| fig-cap: Nighthawk tail length scales allometrically at low breeding latitudes before plateauing (and maybe slightly decreasing) at middle-high latitudes.
#| fig-pos: 'H'

coni <- analysis_df %>% filter(Species == "Nighthawk") 
# Originally assessed using a quadratic function but it makes more sense to assess the relationship descriptively and not impose a symmetrical curve, especially given that this is a post-hoc analysis
coni %>% ggplot(aes(x = B.Lat, y = Tail.comb)) +
  geom_point() + 
  stat_smooth() + 
  labs(x = "Breeding latitude", y = "Tail length")
```

# Variance partitioning

```{r}
#| label: fig-var-partitioning
#| fig-cap: Stacked bar plot showing the unique variance explained by each component of the full model. The unique variance components include latitude, sex, age (in whip-poor-will and European nightjar), shared variance (explained by the model but not uniquely attributable to a variable), and residuals (not explained by the model),
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4.8
#| fig-pos: 'H'

order_fac <- c("Latitude", "Sex", "Age", "Shared", "Residuals")
variance_tbl2 %>%
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = order_fac)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = metric, y = pct, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Species, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percent of variance", fill = "Component") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: supp-pca-loadings

pc_loadings_tbl <- capri_pca1 %>%
  mutate(
    pc_rev = map(pca, \(pc) {
      pc2 <- pc
      pc2$x[, 1:2] <- -pc2$x[, 1:2]
      pc2$rotation[, 1:2] <- -pc2$rotation[, 1:2]
      pc2
    }),
    loadings = map(pc_rev, \(pc) as_tibble(pc$rotation[, 1:2], rownames = "metric"))
  )
```

# PCA biplots and back correlations

```{r}
#| label: fig-pca-biplots
#| fig-cap: PCA biplots of wing, tail, and mass for each species. Points are individuals and vectors show trait loadings; axis orientation is sign-reversed for consistent interpretation across species.
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| fig-pos: 'H'

pca_plots <- pc_loadings_tbl %>%
  mutate(plot = map2(pc_rev, Species, \(pc, sp) {
    fviz_pca_biplot(pc, geom = "point") +
      ggtitle(as.character(sp)) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
  }), .keep = "none") %>%
  pull(plot)

plot_grid(plotlist = pca_plots, nrow = 1, labels = c("a", "b", "c"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pca-interpretation
#| tbl-cap: Back correlations of PC1 onto morphological traits to aid in interpretation of PC1. 
#| tbl-cap-location: bottom
#| tbl-pos: H

pc_loadings <- pc_loadings_tbl %>%
  select(Species, loadings) %>%
  unnest(loadings) %>% 
  select(-PC2) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = PC1) %>% 
  mutate(metric = str_remove(metric, "\\.comb"))

analysis_df %>%
  select(Species, Wing.comb, Mass.comb, Tail.comb, PC1) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(Wing.comb, Mass.comb, Tail.comb),
               names_to = "Trait",
               values_to = "Value") %>% 
  summarize(cor_PC1 = cor(Value, PC1, use="complete.obs"),
            .by = c(Species, Trait)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = cor_PC1) %>% 
  mutate(Trait = str_remove(Trait, "\\.comb"), 
         across(where(is.numeric), round, 2)) %>% 
  gt()
```
